layers_refused.AV SEARCH_DERIVATIVE: refused. Measured here: 5,134 of 5,839 AV mantras lose at least one base letter in that layer (11,582 deletions of 'm' and 5,139 of 'r'), because the normaliser treats U+0323 and U+0325 as accents. Every vocalic r and every anusvara would have been destroyed in matching. See proofs/search_derivative_hazard.json.
